verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is a community report from the CrowdStrike outage. It says Windows' built-in System Restore helped recover affected machines and that 'F8 + last known good configuration' worked for one team. This shows Windows has its own rollback mechanism, but the pack has no first-party documentation of it, and the same report calls it impractical across roughly 500 or more clients. missing for 10: first-party docs on System Restore or restore points, evidence of update-specific rollback (uninstalling an update or going back to a previous build), detail on how snapshots are created and managed, and corroborated hands-on depth beyond a single thread.
